def select_demand(corpus_df):
    fallback_ids = ['n06-r07', 'n06-r08']
    demand_evidence_terms = (
        'job', 'jobs', 'pain', 'trigger', 'alternative', 'alternatives',
        'consequence', 'consequences', 'outcome', 'outcomes', 'observed'
    )
    records = []
    demand_scores = corpus_df.get('demand_score', 0)
    record_ids = corpus_df.get('record_id', '')
    needs = corpus_df.get('need', '')
    evidence_mask = needs.fillna('').astype(str).str.lower().apply(
        lambda need: any(term in need for term in demand_evidence_terms)
    )
    selected_df = corpus_df[((demand_scores >= 3) & evidence_mask) | record_ids.isin(fallback_ids)]
    for _, row in selected_df.iterrows():
        records.append({'record_id': row.get('record_id', ''), 'need': row.get('need', ''), 'demand_score': row.get('demand_score', 0), 'source_id': row.get('source_id', ''), 'source_weight': row.get('source_weight', 0)})
    return pd.DataFrame(records)
